text:
marta: Quick ask — for the retest next week I want an "evidence serializer" bundle that contains: RBAC diffs, audit log slice, KMS key usage snapshot, and minimal repro steps. Who can confirm the shortest checklist so we don't over-send?

sam: I can own the RBAC diff + rollout window. Minimal RBAC artifact = terraform plan diff + generated binding CSV (user,role,expiry). We'll include the exact commit SHA used for the rollout.

li: For audit logs, we'll export a timeboxed slice from the audit topic (kafka: audit-events-prod) covering the window. I recommend 1h before/after the test window. Output will be gzipped and signed. Example export command we use:```bash
kubectl -n observability exec -it svc/kafka-exporter -- /bin/sh -c "kafka-console-consumer --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --topic audit-events-prod --from-beginning --max-messages 100000" | gzip > /tmp/audit-1779123450.gz
```

ellen: KMS note — don't share raw CMKs. Share an access log of KMS decrypt calls and the wrap metadata. We can provide an HMAC-signed manifest showing which keys were used (key ids only), timestamps, and requester principal. If you want to demonstrate replayability, include the wrapping metadata JSON but redact plaintext.

marta: Perfect. Sam — what does the RBAC CSV look like? small sample please.

sam: CSV sample:```csv
principal,role,grant_ts,expires_ts,method
engineer:alice,roles/pt-assessor,1680000000,1680003600,assume-role
service:kgmt,roles/keystore-reader,1680000500,1680004100,service-account
```

li: Once I push the gz to S3, I'll generate a presigned link and checksum + sig. Expect naming: s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1779123450/audit.gz and s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1779123450/rbac.csv. Example presign (internal):

```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-evidence/1779123450/audit.gz --expires-in 604800
```

ellen: Also add a one-line repro for any auth failures: which API call, expected response vs observed, and a minimal curl that reproduces the token exchange. e.g.```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/auth/token -d '{"grant_type":"assume_role","role":"roles/pt-assessor"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <test-token>'
```

marta: Can pen-test-bot confirm upload hooks? We want an automatic sanity check when files land (checksum match + allowed file types).

pen-test-bot: upload-event received for prefix 1779123450. Running checks: checksum OK, gzip header present, allowed-mime: application/gzip. Generating manifest. :white_check_mark:

sam: One more ops-level thing — include the exact IAM session policy used during the window (we attach it in a file named session-policy.json). That prevents surprises about implicit permissions.

li: I'll also capture a 30s tcpdump at the proxy layer for one critical call and redact IPs. That helps triage replay-only issues.

marta: Thanks. Last: retest slot scheduled Thu 10:00 UTC. Owners: RBAC diff & session-policy = sam, audit slice & tcpdump = li, KMS manifest = ellen, packaging + final manifest = me. If anything slips, ping here. :thumbsup:

pen-test-bot: Final manifest uploaded: https://s3.internal.redwood/evidence/1779123450/manifest.json (presigned). Checks: manifest.sig present. :lock:

marta: Cool — closing this thread. I'll attach the manifest to the retest ticket and share with assessors.
